{{Top|leg}}
'''Strag''' was an game of strategy and tactics played on a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] board with a dozen pieces on each side. Ancient by the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it was considered an intellectual pursuit, and mastery required years of practice and an excellent memory.
